sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Direct BracketFormula approach unsound; requires VecEA2 endpoint convention

memory_candidates.content: BracketFormula negation via prepend at first alpha_0 occurrence r_0 is UNSOUND for x_0 > r_0: rightPart.holds(x_0, z_1) does not imply rightPart.holds(r_0, z_1) because the first segment widens from (x_0, w_1) to (r_0, w_1) without beta_1 info on the extra piece. Five approaches were tried and all fail: (1) prepend with alpha_0.neg, (2) prepend with alpha_0.neg.conj beta_0, (3) segment-failure decomposition, (4) F-chain approach, (5) split-at-every-position. The correct approach uses VecEA2 endpoint convention where alpha_0 is at the FIXED endpoint z_0, eliminating x_0 > r_0.
